$comment: LokalBot design tokens for the companion apps. Source of truth: LokalBot/Support/DesignTokens.swift, Brand.swift and DesignSystem.swift; hex values cross-checked with LinuxWindows/crates/lokalbot-app/src/theme.rs. Run `node Companion/design/generate.mjs` after editing.

accentFill.use: Filled buttons, selection knob, citation badges; text on it is white

accentText.use: Links, timestamps, icons, done checks, evidence pills

accentWash.use: Selected rows, playing or cited transcript line

attention.use: Dots and fills: remote-engine marker, pending changes

attentionText.use: Owner unclear, blockers, waiting for your Mac

window.use: Main surface (Android; iOS uses system backgrounds)

elevated.use: Sheets, menus, cards above the window

speakers.$comment: Index 0 is the person themselves (You). Transcript colorIndex -1 uses textSupporting.

nameColor.$comment: App and project colours on the Timeline, matching the Mac's CaptureStyle.color: hue = djb2(name) % 360 with a 64-bit unsigned wrapping hash (start 5381, hash = hash * 33 + byte over the UTF-8 bytes), saturation 0.55, brightness 0.78 (HSB). 'Other' uses textSupporting at 55% opacity. The Windows and Linux app still hashes in 32 bits.

motion.$comment: Seconds. All off under Reduce Motion / Remove animations.

type.$comment: Roles from LBTokens.TextRole mapped to each platform's scalable styles.
